scripts.test: vitest run --project unit --project rls --project events --project schema-compat
scripts.s3:up: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile s3 up -d --wait minio
scripts.s3:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile s3 stop minio
scripts.llm:up: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile llm up -d --wait litellm
scripts.llm:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile llm stop litellm
scripts.memory:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile memory stop hindsight
scripts.e2e: pnpm -C e2e exec playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
